policy.name: Native Refine General Agent Loop - Interactive Candidates

selection.selection_rule: Exact user-endorsed asset, appearance, native retention, semantics, additions, display gates, structure, physics, recency; unknown is not passed.
selection.scope: Best available display evidence among saved candidates; not a guarantee of physical or perceptual optimality.

selection.selector: Use the recorded Z-up native frame: blade points toward -X, handles toward +X, broad blade normal is Z. Let c be each stable triangle centroid. Scale native coordinates uniformly by 0.255/0.9992841184139252 metres; this size is an editable prior, not measured. Both rigid rest roots have identity orientation and origin at native P=(-0.13,0,0), mapped to world origin. Initial actionable ownership: pivot-cap faces with (cx+0.13)^2+cy^2 < 0.026^2 and abs(cz)>0.016 belong to reference_branch. Other faces with cx>-0.13 use cy>0 for moving_branch and cy<=0 for reference_branch; faces with cx<=-0.13 use cz<0 for moving_branch and cz>=0 for reference_branch. At the overlap, trace each thin layer into its shank using face adjacency and nearest same-layer seeds, allowing local boundary adjustment within 0.05 native units of P to avoid disconnected slivers. Preserve all source faces exactly once. The positive-Z notched blade is provisionally paired to the negative-Y handle, the rear blade to the positive-Y handle, following the crossing visible in input and top views. This is editable estimated correspondence, not recovered hidden hardware. Active patch S comprises reference_branch handle faces with 0.12<cx<0.28, -0.20<cy<-0.125, cz>0.008; retain the largest edge-connected patch in that box. This is a local upper-facing outer grip patch, excluding metal, finger openings and all other native faces. All reference_branch faces from the shared partition, MINUS S; includes the circular pivot cap, notched front blade, shank, negative-Y handle and adjacent inward teeth.
selection.reason: Layer overlap and crossed shanks support two coupled rigid branches; handle color regions are not separate joints.

mass.reason: Editable branch mass; no calibrated mass evidence.

interactions.name: opening_preview
interactions.action: Provide a browser slider from 0 to pi/2 and return. During construction only, inspect static transforms at 0, pi/4, pi/2 using the real owner hierarchy to ensure blade, shank, teeth, covering and handle remain visibly attached. This is a binding/continuity inspection, not an endpoint physical test.
interactions.expected: Relative opening of complete branches around the same fastener; no detached handles or stationary moving-blade surface.

interactions.name: grip_preview
interactions.action: Expose bounded 0 to 0.001 m nonrigid indentation control with edge taper on dedicated skin; construct genuine flex and weights but never execute dynamics.
interactions.expected: Visible local indentation with preserved surrounding surface and explicit parameter-preview label; no load or recovery pass.

review_requirements: During construction, account for every native face exactly once across reference_branch, moving_branch and grip_patch. Preserve rest geometry, UVs and PBR; verify the patch is nonempty and excluded from rigid surfaces. Keep finger openings and the notch visibly open. This is artifact integrity inspection, not physical validation.

Inspect static joint transforms at 0, pi/4 and pi/2 only. Confirm the moving blade, shank, handle and inward teeth follow moving_branch together, while the reference assembly stays fixed; both branches remain visibly connected at the estimated pivot. Inspect surfaces rather than joint values alone, using supported visual-root offsets. These are construction binding poses, not simulated endpoints or contact tests.

Construct the coarse grip flex discretization and dedicated native skin with valid nonnegative normalized binding weights and supported offsets. At rest, reconstruct the native patch; with the bounded 0-to-0.001 m parameter control, show interior skin deformation with pinned boundary continuity. Retain rigid-follow ownership of deferred coverings. Label the control as a parameter preview; execute no loading, recovery or dynamics test.

Save the native-preserving GLB, editable Blender source, MJCF and interactive metadata. Keep pivot_opening limited=true with the declared finite range and expose the opening and local indentation controls. Publish promptly after construction with physics_status=not_tested and physics_attempts=0; report construction gaps without manufacturing physical reports or pass claims.

interaction_coverage.label: Open and close the opposed blade/handle assemblies
interaction_coverage.reason: Visible blade overlap, fastener and separate handles support one finite relative opening action, not continuous rotation.

interaction_coverage.label: Bring the opposed inner teeth together
interaction_coverage.reason: The same hinge moves the adjacent inward teeth with their real handle owners. No independent jaw joint or crushing-performance claim is needed.

interaction_coverage.label: Local grip indentation
interaction_coverage.reason: Potential soft grip gets one actual deforming visible binding; browser parameter preview is not physics.

interaction_coverage.label: Other grip coverings
interaction_coverage.reason: Additional compliance follows its existing branch rigidly while the active patch remains deformable.

interaction_coverage.label: Curved notch engagement
interaction_coverage.reason: The notch is visible but does not establish a separate moving mechanism or contact function.
interaction_coverage.attempt_plan: Preserve native notch with its blade owner and opening preview; leave engagement and cutting/crushing performance untested because external targets and physical testing are outside scope.

deferred_compliance.name: reference_covering_rest
deferred_compliance.reason: All reference handle covering outside the small active S patch keeps native geometry and rigid ownership; its material remains potentially compliant.

deferred_compliance.name: moving_covering
deferred_compliance.reason: Moving handle covering follows its branch unchanged; additional flex volume is deferred while grip_patch supplies the active visible attempt.

approximation_gaps.reason: Native hidden blade surfaces, thickness split and newly exposed seams are approximate; no new visual geometry authorized. Preserve all source faces/UV/PBR and retain generous motion.

Simple per-blade boxes and short handle-rim capsules suffice for MJCF construction; concave tooth/notch detail and blade sliding contact are approximate and entirely untested. Keep finger openings free of solid spanning proxies.
Only one local grip patch deforms; other coverings rigid-follow. Material constants, support thickness and deformation control are priors; no physical soft success or recovery is claimed.
